cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank everyone equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It helped enormously.

beats.text: With what?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keeping track of the bookings.

beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making me look selfish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
